ev.q: the adjusted VE against SARI hospitalization associated with any influenza virus during the 2023 Southern Hemisphere season was 51.9%
Among SARI patients, 15.3% of case-patients had received a 2023 seasonal influenza vaccine, compared with 28.0% of control patients
Analyses were stratified by influenza type and subtype (when available)
Vaccine effectiveness was estimated using mixed effects logistic models adjusting for age in years
VE against influenza-associated hospitalization was estimated using a test-negative case-control study design

methods_quotes.q: VE was estimated using mixed effects logistic models adjusting for age in years (fit as cubic spline), week of symptom onset (fit as cubic spline)
Analyses were stratified by influenza type and subtype (when available)
P-values <0.05 and 95% CIs that did not include zero were considered statistically significant.
A Pearson’s chi-square test was used to ascertain whether there were differences in the numbers of persons who were vaccinated and unvaccinated
